text: Reaching <1.33 rs completes objective 1, then starts objective 2 'Hold for 20 seconds' which completes 6 ticks later (tick 3142) and is replaced by objective 3 'Hold at twice the relay rate: 20 s to go'. Looks like a duplicated/renamed hold objective inflating the count.

After the 20 s hold completes (tick 4341 'Held for 20 seconds'), the objective box disappears entirely and Ines asks 'is the camera broken?' with no reply from WREN; player has no on-screen instruction to return up.

Helm panel: once the rear-camera feed appears the panel overflows and scrolls; scrolled content (the 'Hold station at' slider row and its value) shows through behind the translucent 'Step back' header bar at top, garbled text. Also the first click on 'Return to 10 rs' at (810,262) did nothing because the panel had scrolled under the pointer.

Probe console in-world screen says 'K-1 ready' alongside Orpheus, though Ines just said 'One probe left. Orpheus.' (K-1 was spent in the earlier probe chapter). Panel also describes Orpheus as carrying 'a clock and a beacon' without mentioning the camera that is the whole point.

After WREN says 'No more frames are coming' (tick 10771), the Orpheus feed panel still reads 'Next frame due: 1.3 s' (and the number creeps upward), contradicting the dialogue. Expected the 'next frame' line to change to something like 'no further frames will arrive'.

Refinement: frame 65 (sent from 1.211 rs) actually arrived after WREN's 'No more frames are coming' line; only now does the panel read 'Next frame due: never'. The dialogue fires one frame too early. Objective 'Watch the Orpheus feed' still not completed at tick 11959.
